segment.description: Harpeth River Williamson County reaches near Franklin — a mostly warmwater river whose only trout element is TWRA's winter put-and-take season stocking catchable rainbow trout at Eastern Flank Battle Park (December-February window per the schedule). Not the TDEC-designated scenic-river segments (those are Rutherford + Davidson counties only).
segment.boundaries: Stocked site: 'Harpeth River at Eastern Flank Battle Park', Franklin (TWRA 2026 schedule). USGS 03432350 'HARPETH RIVER AT FRANKLIN, TN' brackets the stocked corridor on-reach; USGS 03433500 (Bellevue) is downstream in Davidson County, outside the catalog segment.

coldSource.notes: USGS 03432350 'HARPETH RIVER AT FRANKLIN, TN': Williamson County (FIPS 187), HUC 05130204, altitude 604.54 ft, drainage 192 sq mi, free-flowing river station (https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?sites=03432350&siteOutput=expanded&format=rdb). TRAP CONFIRMED BY CONSULTATION: TDEC's scenic-river designation for the Harpeth covers Rutherford and Davidson county segments only (21.1 mi); the 1972 designation language explicitly excludes 'those segments located in Cheatham, Dickson and Williamson counties' — so this catalog's Williamson reaches are not the scenic-river segments, and the TDEC page names no fish species (https://www.tn.gov/environment/natural-areas/tn-scenic-rivers/harpeth.html).

holdover.detail: No holdover evidence located; the documented program is the winter urban put-and-take (stockings 1/23/2026, 2/20/2026 and TBD 12/2026 per the row-level schedule).

wildPopulation.detail: Absent from TWRA's Wild Trout Streams list; no Harpeth trout regulation or wild-trout record exists (no Harpeth entry on TWRA's trout regulations page).

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: The only trout program is a winter-only catchable rainbow put-and-take (Dec-Feb) at a Franklin park, while the on-reach USGS gauge at Franklin recorded 27.5 C water in August and TWRA maintains no trout regulation or wild-trout status for the river.
